Website proposal

by Farah

A private salon online. A website that shows your work the way you present it in person, and that you can run yourself.

The idea

Most of your clients find you on Instagram. The website is where they decide to book.

You are a private jeweler: custom diamond jewelry, designed by an HRD-certified gemologist and seen by appointment. The site does not try to sell online. It presents your work beautifully, explains how a custom piece comes to life, and makes it easy to ask for an appointment, by form or straight on WhatsApp.

The look is calm and warm: ivory and soft beige taken from the velvet trays in your photos, with the deep brown and gold of your business card for the logo and accents, a fine classic typeface, plenty of space around every piece.

Your logo

Your mark, redrawn for the screen

I redrew the logo from your business card as a clean vector file, so it stays sharp at every size: on the website, on a phone, in print. Gold on brown for dark backgrounds, brown on gold for light ones.

How it will look

Quiet luxury, on every screen

The homepage on a computer

And on a phone

What visitors will find

Five pages, each with one job

Home

A large photo, a few chosen pieces, how a custom piece is made, the latest Instagram posts and a clear "Book an appointment".

Collection

The pieces you have made, grouped into sections such as Engagement, Rings, Bracelets, Necklaces and Evil eye. Each piece has its own page with photos and a short story.

About us

Your story, your gemologist background, the meaning of the name, and press and celebrity moments.

Events

Trunk shows, private viewings and pop-ups, with date and place. Past events stay as a little archive.

Contact

An appointment request form, WhatsApp, phone and email. The address can stay private and be shared once an appointment is confirmed.

Every piece

Show the price, or keep it private

Prices are an option, never an obligation. You decide per piece whether the price is shown; without one, the site says "Price on request". You can also hide prices for a whole section at once. A piece can be marked as sold and stay on the site as past work.

Every piece page has a button that opens WhatsApp with the name of the piece already typed in, so a question takes one tap.

Ask about this piece on WhatsApp

Run by you

You change the site yourself, from your phone

A private, password-protected page lets you update everything without calling anyone. No technical knowledge needed: it works like filling in a form.

Add new pieces

Take photos, add a name and a few words, choose the section. Photos are resized automatically so the site stays fast.

Organise the collection

Create sections, rename them and move them up or down. Move pieces between sections or change their order.

Hide for a while

Take a piece or a whole section off the site temporarily, and bring it back with one tap. Nothing is lost.

Show a price, or not

Per piece or per section. Without a price, the site says "Price on request".

Create events

A name, a date, a place and a photo. Past events move to the archive by themselves.

See appointment requests

Every request from the site lands in one list, with the person's details, ready for you to call back or message.

Change the texts

The words on the homepage and About us in English, Dutch and French, the WhatsApp number, phone and email.

Choose Instagram posts

New posts appear on the site by themselves every day. You can hide any post from the site.

Instagram, built in

Your feed, on the site

Your latest posts from @58diamondsbyfarah appear on the homepage automatically. The photos are kept on the website itself, so they always load quickly and never disappear.

Delivered in one go

What I need from you

A few things to make it yours

Your story

A few paragraphs about you and 58 Diamonds, and what the name means.

Photos

The original photos of your pieces, and one of yourself. Instagram copies are compressed.

Contact details

WhatsApp number, phone, email, and whether to show the address.

Logo

I have redrawn it from your card. The original file from your printer would let me match the gold exactly.

Translations

A check of the Dutch and French texts, or your own wording where you prefer it.
